reports.title: eBay Inc. Reports Third Quarter 2026 Results

guidance.heading: Business Outlook
section: eBay is providing the following guidance for continuing operations for the fourth quarter and full year 2026. This outlook includes the expected impact from Depop.

(In billions, except per share data and percentages) | Q4 2026 Guidance | Full Year 2026 Guidance
Revenue | $3.19 - $3.24 | $12.62 - $12.67
FX-Neutral Y/Y Growth | 7% - 9% | 12% - 13%
Gross Merchandise Volume | $23.7 - $24.1 | $91.5 - $91.9
FX-Neutral Y/Y Growth | 12% - 14% | 14% - 14%
Diluted GAAP EPS | $0.82 - $0.87 | $4.26 - $4.31
Diluted Non-GAAP EPS | $1.48 - $1.53 | $6.25 - $6.30
